RIGGING FAILURE/DROPPED LOAD PROCEDURES:

1. Clear area immediately - evacuate to assembly point

2. Account for all personnel - check for injuries

3. Call 911 if injuries - advise "dropped load with crush injuries"

4. DO NOT attempt to move victim unless immediate danger

5. Secure area - prevent unauthorized access

6. Preserve scene for investigation

7. Notify supervisor and safety officer immediately

CONFINED SPACE EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

1. DO NOT ENTER - most rescuers become victims

2. Call 911 immediately - advise "confined space emergency"

3. Activate ventilation to maximum

4. Attempt to communicate with victim

5. Retrieve victim using retrieval line if attached and conscious

6. Wait for trained rescue team - provide information about space

7. Have SDS available for any chemicals involved

PRESSURE TEST RUPTURE PROCEDURES:

1. Immediately isolate pressure source

2. DO NOT enter area until pressure fully relieved

3. Account for all personnel

4. Call 911 if injuries - advise "high pressure rupture"

5. Provide first aid for projectile injuries (do not remove embedded objects)

6. Secure area - investigate cause
